note.title: Reading nutrition labels
note.overview: Food-label comparisons require the same basis and units, with values scaled to the actual amount eaten.

Apply the knowledge rather than relying on recognition alone.
Use the command word and include every required scientific point.
mustMemoriseRules: Amount eaten = per-100-g value x portion mass / 100.
Check whether data are per 100 g, per serving or per pack.
kJ and kcal both measure energy but are not interchangeable.
